prehab_drills.name: Band Face Pulls
prehab_drills.desc: Squeeze rear delts and externally rotate shoulders at peak contraction.

prehab_drills.name: Shoulder Dislocates (Band/PVC)
prehab_drills.desc: Keep arms straight and core tight while moving band overhead front-to-back.

prehab_drills.name: Y-T-W Band Raises
prehab_drills.desc: Target lower traps and rotator cuff stability through controlled raises.

prehab_drills.name: Bird-Dog Holds
prehab_drills.desc: Extend opposite arm and leg while maintaining a neutral spine and brace.

prehab_drills.name: Cat-Cow Spine Mobilization
prehab_drills.desc: Gently articulate thoracic and lumbar spine without forcing range.

prehab_drills.name: McGill Curl-Ups
prehab_drills.desc: Hands under lower back, lift head/shoulders slightly to activate deep core.

prehab_drills.name: Tibialis Bodyweight Raises
prehab_drills.desc: Lean against wall, flex toes up to strengthen tibialis anterior muscle.

prehab_drills.name: Spanish Squat Iso-Holds
prehab_drills.desc: Use band behind knees to sit back into isometric squat; unloads patellar tendon.

prehab_drills.name: Terminal Knee Extensions (TKEs)
prehab_drills.desc: Attach band behind knee joint and contract quad into full lockout.

prehab_drills.name: Dynamic Wrist Flexor/Extensor Sweeps
prehab_drills.desc: Gently flex and extend wrist under light tension to promote blood flow.

prehab_drills.name: Quadruped Wrist Rocks
prehab_drills.desc: On hands and knees, gently rock bodyweight over hands in multiple angles.
